title: Line Art
look: A single thin line around every piece on white paper; colour only in the eyes.

doc.essence: An architect's line drawing of the character: every shape edged by one even thin line, filled with paper.
doc.notIt: Not ink (thin, even, and every inner shape is outlined too).
doc.shapes: Every body shape gets a thin edge in the fill pass.
doc.colour: Black on white, pink cheeks only.
pitfalls: Thick stroke limbs show as filled bars.
